Enum Class IkePattern

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<IkePattern>
network.ike.foundation.ike.bindings.IkePattern
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.ikm.tinkar.component.Component, dev.ikm.tinkar.component.Pattern, dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.ComponentWithNid, dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.EntityFacade, dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.PatternEnumerationFacade<IkePattern>, dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.PatternFacade, Serializable, Comparable<IkePattern>, Constable
public enum IkePattern extends Enum<IkePattern> implements dev.ikm.tinkar.terms.PatternEnumerationFacade<IkePattern>
Generated bindings for the knowledge set d890e06f-ec35-429a-b541-d0ead19695e2 — DO NOT EDIT. A component's identity is T5(setUuid, fullyQualifiedNameAtBirth) unless the ledger adopted an established one; regenerate from the ledger.

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ACTION_DEFINITION_PATTERN
    The definition of the action concept it references: the pattern each run's input takes, the pattern its result takes, and the instructions a model needs when it performs the action.
    ANNOTATION_PATTERN
    An annotation of the referenced component: its kind, the reviewed version's STAMP, the elements it covers (empty for the whole component), and its text (empty when there is none).
    ASCIIDOC_CITATION_PATTERN
    A citation on a line: its key and the bibliography entry it resolved to.
    ASCIIDOC_CONDITIONAL_PATTERN
    A conditional directive: the attribute it tests and whether it is negated.
    ASCIIDOC_CROSS_REFERENCE_PATTERN
    A cross reference on a line: its target anchor and display text.
    ASCIIDOC_DOCUMENT_ATTRIBUTES_PATTERN
    A document's title and topic attributes, one version per commit that changed them; absent attributes are empty.
    ASCIIDOC_ESTIMATE_MARK_PATTERN
    An estimate mark on a line, with the note the mark carries.
    ASCIIDOC_FOOTNOTE_PATTERN
    A footnote on a line.
    ASCIIDOC_INCLUDE_PATTERN
    An include directive: its target and verbatim parameters.
    ASCIIDOC_INDEX_TERM_REFERENCE_PATTERN
    An index term on a line: the text as written and the concept it resolved to.
    ASCIIDOC_LINK_PATTERN
    A link on a line: its URL and display text.
    CHANGE_TRANSACTION_PATTERN
    A transaction that wrote uncommitted versions, referencing the change tracking module, with the transaction's UUID as its identity and its author on every version's stamp: its name, its state, its basis (time, path, and any external basis such as a git commit), and, while it is open, the components it has written.
    COMMENT_PATTERN
    Comment pattern
    COMPONENT_ACTION_INPUT_PATTERN
    The input of an action that takes nothing but its subject, the referenced component: the kind of action performed on it.
    COMPONENT_CHRONOLOGY_PATTERN
    Component Chronology Pattern
    COMPONENT_VERSION_PATTERN
    Component Version Pattern
    CONCEPT_FIELD_PATTERN
    Concept field pattern
    CONCEPT_VERSION_PATTERN
    Concept Version Pattern
    CONSTRUCT_DENOTATION_PATTERN
    Construct Denotation Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    CONSTRUCT_RELATION_PATTERN
    Construct Relation Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    CQL_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the CQL dialect.
    DATA_MODEL_RECORD_PATTERN
    What a model information file says of the model itself, kept verbatim: its name, version, and url, the model it stands on, its qualifier, its patient class and birth date element, its default context, and its flags.
    DATA_TYPE_DEFAULTS_PATTERN
    Data Type Defaults Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    DESCRIPTION_PATTERN
    Description Pattern
    DOCUMENT_BLOCK_EDIT_INPUT_PATTERN
    The input of an action that replaces the text of a document block, the referenced component, which is the block's element semantic: the kind of action performed on it and the block's new text.
    DOCUMENT_BLOCK_PATTERN
    One element of a structured document — a section, a block, a row, a cell, a list, an item or a turn — with its kind, level, title, verbatim parameters and ordered members; a new version only when one of these changes.
    ECL_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the ECL dialect.
    EL_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the EL++ dialect.
    EL_INFERRED_AXIOMS_PATTERN
    EL++ Inferred Axioms Pattern
    EL_STATED_AXIOMS_PATTERN
    EL++ Stated Axioms Pattern
    ELM_ORDERED_LIST_PATTERN
    The items an ELM list position holds, in order, each an ELM tree of its own, about the definition whose tree points at the list.
    ELM_REFERENCE_PATTERN
    One thing a definition names, about the definition semantic that names it: the kind of thing, the definition it is as a link, and the names as written.
    ELM_TREE_PATTERN
    One definition of a library, or the library's own identity record, as one tree of ELM nodes, about the library concept.
    ELM_TYPE_POSITION_PATTERN
    ELM type position pattern (ELM)
    EXPRESSION_LANGUAGE_KEYWORD_PATTERN
    Expression Language Keyword Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    FHIR_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the FHIR dialect.
    GB_DIALECT_PATTERN
    GB Dialect Pattern
    GIT_SOURCE_PATTERN
    A document's git source: path and commit, one version per commit that changed the file.
    IDENTIFIER_PATTERN
    Identifier Pattern
    IKE_BASE_MODEL_COMPONENT_PATTERN
    IKE base model component pattern
    INFERRED_EQUIVALENCE_PATTERN
    The concepts classification found the referenced concept logically equivalent to, never including the concept itself.
    INFERRED_NAVIGATION_PATTERN
    Inferred Navigation Pattern
    JOURNAL_MANIFEST_PATTERN
    Holds the ordered lines of one structured document; a new version per insert, removal or reorder, so replay walks manifest versions in time.
    KNOWLEDGE_BASE_COMPOSITION_PATTERN
    How the knowledge base was assembled, referencing this pattern: the inputs with their checksums, the source releases in the order they arrived, the classifier, and when it ran.
    KOMET_BASE_MODEL_COMPONENT_PATTERN
    Komet base model component pattern
    LITERAL_DENOTATION_PATTERN
    Literal Denotation Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    MODEL_CLASS_BRIDGE_PATTERN
    The criterion a retrievable class stands for, on the class: the circumstance kind a statement must hold, the disposition it must carry when the class fixes one, and the relation kind the bridge claims.
    MODEL_CLASS_MARK_PATTERN
    The mark on one of IKE's own patterns that writes it into model information as a class: the model the class belongs to, whether a library may retrieve it, and the field that carries its code.
    MODEL_CLASS_PATTERN
    What a model information file says of one class, kept verbatim, and what IKE resolved of it: the kind, namespace, name, identifier, and label, the base type as written and as a concept, whether retrievable, the code path as written and as the element it names, the value set path, the target as written and as a concept, the description, the comment, and the model the class belongs to.
    MODEL_CONTEXT_PATTERN
    A context a library may run in, as the file writes it on the model: its name, the class that is the context as written and as a concept, the element that keys it, and the element that carries its birth date.
    MODEL_CONTEXT_RELATIONSHIP_PATTERN
    How a class reaches a context, as the file writes it on the class: the context's name and its record, the element by which the class reaches it, and whether the file declares the relationship on the target model.
    MODEL_CONVERSION_PATTERN
    A conversion the file declares between two types, about the type converted from: the two types as written, the type converted to as a concept, and the function the file names, which the translator writes into a library as an explicit call.
    MODEL_ELEMENT_PATTERN
    What a model information file says of one element of a class, kept verbatim, and what IKE resolved of it: the name, the type as written, the class the type names when it names one, the type as a tree of the catalog's type specifiers, the bounds, the prohibited, must support, and one based flags, the target, the label, the description, the definition, the comment, and the binding's name, strength, and value set.
    MODEL_ELEMENT_READING_PATTERN
    The statement reading a model's element answers, on the element record, so that a property access on a statement reads the timing, the result, the topic, or the subject's fact the element stands for.
    MODEL_REQUIREMENT_PATTERN
    A model this model requires, as the file writes it, and that model's concept in the store, which must be there before this model is imported.
    MODULE_ORIGINS_PATTERN
    Module origins pattern (SOLOR)
    OWL_AXIOM_SYNTAX_PATTERN
    OWL Axiom Syntax Pattern
    PATH_ORIGINS_PATTERN
    Path origins pattern (SOLOR)
    PATTERN_CHRONOLOGY_PATTERN
    Pattern Chronology Pattern
    PATTERN_VERSION_PATTERN
    Pattern Version Pattern
    PREFERRED_REVIEWER_PATTERN
    Preferred Reviewer Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    PROSE_ELEMENT_PATTERN
    An embedded prose block: text whose id-bearing k: tokens are the interchange form.
    QDM_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the QDM dialect.
    QI_CORE_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the QI-Core dialect.
    QUICK_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the QUICK dialect.
    SEMANTIC_CHRONOLOGY_PATTERN
    Semantic Chronology Pattern
    SEMANTIC_VERSION_FIELD_PATTERN
    Semantic version field pattern
    SOLOR_CONCEPT_ASSEMBLAGE
    SOLOR concept assemblage (SOLOR)
    SOLOR_CONCEPTS_PATTERN
    Solor Concepts Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    SOURCE_RELEASE_PATTERN
    A source release imported into the knowledge base, referencing a module the import wrote: the release's name and date, the artifact and its checksum, the importer, the modules written, and the source releases it was layered on.
    STAMP_CHRONOLOGY_PATTERN
    STAMP Chronology Pattern
    STAMP_VERSION_FIELD_PATTERN
    STAMP version field pattern
    STARTER_SET_AUTHOR_ROSTER_PATTERN
    Starter Set Author Roster Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    STATED_NAVIGATION_PATTERN
    Stated Navigation Pattern
    TAXONOMY_FIELD_CONSTRAINT_PATTERN
    Taxonomy Field Constraint Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    UCUM_COMPOSED_UNIT_PATTERN
    A unit composed by UCUM's grammar: its canonical code, IKE's dimension and magnitude for it, and whether any factor is special or arbitrary, in which case it does not convert.
    UCUM_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the UCUM dialect.
    UCUM_PREFIX_PATTERN
    What UCUM says of one prefix, kept verbatim: the code, the case-insensitive code, the print symbol, and the factor.
    UCUM_UNIT_PATTERN
    What UCUM says of one unit, kept verbatim, and what IKE computes from it: the code, the case-insensitive code, the print symbol, the class, whether metric, special, or arbitrary, the definition's value and unit as written, and IKE's dimension and magnitude.
    US_CORE_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the US Core dialect.
    US_DIALECT_PATTERN
    Records whether a description is preferred or acceptable in the United States English dialect — one field, that description's acceptability for this dialect.
    VALUE_CONSTRAINT_PATTERN
    Value Constraint Pattern
    VALUE_SET_FIELD_CONSTRAINT_PATTERN
    Value-set Field Constraint Pattern (IkeFoundation)
    VERSION_CHANGE_RESULT_PATTERN
    The result of an action that writes a new version of its subject, referencing the run's input: the outcome, the STAMP of the version written (the outcome concept itself when nothing was written), and a message.
    VERSION_CONTROL_PATH_PATTERN
    Version control path pattern

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CLASS_PATTERN
      What a model information file says of one class, kept verbatim, and what IKE resolved of it: the kind, namespace, name, identifier, and label, the base type as written and as a concept, whether retrievable, the code path as written and as the element it names, the value set path, the target as written and as a concept, the description, the comment, and the model the class belongs to. The definition text is the concept's definition.

    • MODEL_ELEMENT_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_ELEMENT_PATTERN
      What a model information file says of one element of a class, kept verbatim, and what IKE resolved of it: the name, the type as written, the class the type names when it names one, the type as a tree of the catalog's type specifiers, the bounds, the prohibited, must support, and one based flags, the target, the label, the description, the definition, the comment, and the binding's name, strength, and value set. One semantic per element, about its class.

    • MODEL_CONTEXT_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CONTEXT_PATTERN
      A context a library may run in, as the file writes it on the model: its name, the class that is the context as written and as a concept, the element that keys it, and the element that carries its birth date. One semantic per context, about the model.

    • MODEL_CONTEXT_RELATIONSHIP_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CONTEXT_RELATIONSHIP_PATTERN
      How a class reaches a context, as the file writes it on the class: the context's name and its record, the element by which the class reaches it, and whether the file declares the relationship on the target model. One semantic per relationship, about the class.

    • MODEL_CONVERSION_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CONVERSION_PATTERN
      A conversion the file declares between two types, about the type converted from: the two types as written, the type converted to as a concept, and the function the file names, which the translator writes into a library as an explicit call.

    • MODEL_CLASS_MARK_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CLASS_MARK_PATTERN
      The mark on one of IKE's own patterns that writes it into model information as a class: the model the class belongs to, whether a library may retrieve it, and the field that carries its code. Every field of the pattern becomes an element whose type follows from the field's data type.

    • MODEL_CLASS_BRIDGE_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_CLASS_BRIDGE_PATTERN
      The criterion a retrievable class stands for, on the class: the circumstance kind a statement must hold, the disposition it must carry when the class fixes one, and the relation kind the bridge claims. The topic constraint takes the retrieve's codes through the class's code path, which the class record resolves.

    • MODEL_ELEMENT_READING_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern MODEL_ELEMENT_READING_PATTERN
      The statement reading a model's element answers, on the element record, so that a property access on a statement reads the timing, the result, the topic, or the subject's fact the element stands for.

    • SOLOR_CONCEPTS_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern SOLOR_CONCEPTS_PATTERN
      Solor Concepts Pattern (IkeFoundation)

    • INFERRED_EQUIVALENCE_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern INFERRED_EQUIVALENCE_PATTERN
      The concepts classification found the referenced concept logically equivalent to, never including the concept itself. Written beside the inferred navigation semantic only for a concept with equivalents; when a later classification finds none, the set is empty.

    • ANNOTATION_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern ANNOTATION_PATTERN
      An annotation of the referenced component: its kind, the reviewed version's STAMP, the elements it covers (empty for the whole component), and its text (empty when there is none).

    • ACTION_DEFINITION_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern ACTION_DEFINITION_PATTERN
      The definition of the action concept it references: the pattern each run's input takes, the pattern its result takes, and the instructions a model needs when it performs the action.

    • COMPONENT_ACTION_INPUT_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern COMPONENT_ACTION_INPUT_PATTERN
      The input of an action that takes nothing but its subject, the referenced component: the kind of action performed on it.

    • DOCUMENT_BLOCK_EDIT_INPUT_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern DOCUMENT_BLOCK_EDIT_INPUT_PATTERN
      The input of an action that replaces the text of a document block, the referenced component, which is the block's element semantic: the kind of action performed on it and the block's new text.

    • VERSION_CHANGE_RESULT_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern VERSION_CHANGE_RESULT_PATTERN
      The result of an action that writes a new version of its subject, referencing the run's input: the outcome, the STAMP of the version written (the outcome concept itself when nothing was written), and a message.

    • SOURCE_RELEASE_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern SOURCE_RELEASE_PATTERN
      A source release imported into the knowledge base, referencing a module the import wrote: the release's name and date, the artifact and its checksum, the importer, the modules written, and the source releases it was layered on. Written under the source's own stamp, one per importer.

    • KNOWLEDGE_BASE_COMPOSITION_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern KNOWLEDGE_BASE_COMPOSITION_PATTERN
      How the knowledge base was assembled, referencing this pattern: the inputs with their checksums, the source releases in the order they arrived, the classifier, and when it ran. One record per knowledge base; each assembly is a new version.

    • CHANGE_TRANSACTION_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern CHANGE_TRANSACTION_PATTERN
      A transaction that wrote uncommitted versions, referencing the change tracking module, with the transaction's UUID as its identity and its author on every version's stamp: its name, its state, its basis (time, path, and any external basis such as a git commit), and, while it is open, the components it has written. Its uncommitted stamps are not listed: each derives from the transaction's UUID. Written in the change tracking module under committed stamps of its own, one version per lifecycle event.

    • DATA_TYPE_DEFAULTS_PATTERN

      public static final IkePattern DATA_TYPE_DEFAULTS_PATTERN
      Data Type Defaults Pattern (IkeFoundation)

    • DOCUMENT_BLOCK_PATTERN

      One element of a structured document — a section, a block, a row, a cell, a list, an item or a turn — with its kind, level, title, verbatim parameters and ordered members; a new version only when one of these changes.
